description: This file defines the 'Location' class as part of a reporting filter system within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base class for filter fields and implements functionality specific to filtering by location, including adding location-based conditions to query builders, parsing location IDs, and converting location data to array form.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a filter field for location selection in reports, offering methods for query manipulation and data normalization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds location-based filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and selected location IDs.

methods.name: getLocationIds
methods.description: Returns an array of location IDs parsed from the 'x' parameter.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns array of entity aliases used in query joins, here ['location'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the location ID(s) into an array containing the location's ID and name for use in reports.
